dedupe_keys.name: inide nicaragua iv national agricultural census cenagro 2011 farm microdata in spss with irrigation water sources farm installations and machinery including irrigation pumps generators and solar panels

description: The IV National Agricultural Census of Nicaragua was collected by INIDE with the agriculture ministry from 15 May to 16 June 2011, and INIDE publishes its microdata as SPSS files, each also in a zip archive, with the questionnaire, methodology notes and a database manual. There are separate files for farm holdings, parcel tenure and land use, annual, permanent and other crops, machinery and equipment, and household characteristics. The questionnaire asks whether the farm is irrigated, the water source (river, lake, spring, rainwater harvesting, dam, hand-dug or artesian well, estuary or public network), the irrigation method and the irrigated area. It lists on-farm installations such as water tanks, silos, warehouses and drying yards, and machinery such as electric motors, generators, solar panels, irrigation pumps and windmills. Format and access: free downloads of SAV files and zips from the INIDE page with no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the files are records per farm and parcel, so users must aggregate them; area is measured in manzanas; a fifth agricultural census was announced for 2025 but no results were seen. Simulation uses: rural water demand and irrigation infrastructure, off-grid energy use on farms, and drought exposure of irrigated land. Related records: the INIDE 2005 population and housing census database.

name: INIDE Nicaragua IV National Agricultural Census (CENAGRO 2011) farm microdata in SPSS with irrigation, water sources, farm installations and machinery including irrigation pumps, generators and solar panels
provider: Instituto Nacional de Información de Desarrollo (INIDE), with the agriculture ministry (MAGFOR)
schema_summary: Nine SPSS files: 01 farm holdings, 29 parcel tenure, 34 parcel land use, 40 annual crops, 42 oilseed crops, 43 other temporary crops, 44 permanent and semi-permanent crops, 77 machinery and equipment, and household characteristics. Questionnaire section V water sources and irrigated area: irrigation yes or no, water source (river, lake, spring, rainwater harvesting, dam, hand-dug well, artesian well, estuary, public network), irrigation type (gravity, drip, sprinkler, manual) and irrigated area. Installations include water tanks, drinking water troughs, grain and forage silos, warehouses and drying yards. Machinery includes electric motors, generators, solar panels, irrigation pumps, windmills, trucks and boats.
